decisions.reason: The accelerator program sits outside the firm's core machinery business, but it costs little to run and its value through partnerships and deal flow is still unresolved, so the option stays open for now despite a sizable risk of being cut.
The CO2-negative bio-bitumen is a flagship with large but highly uncertain upside, and one year of evidence is too early to show its value is unlikely, so the firm keeps the option open.

The infectious waste plant is a flagship built close to the core offer through the ERMAFA partnership, so keeping it is cheap and its prospects are still unfolding, which supports a further commitment.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's decentralized recycling strategy and existing manufacturing capabilities, so it is cheap to maintain and has promising, still-resolving prospects.
